name: OPENXRD
description: Evaluates models' ability to answer questions about X-ray diffraction (XRD) images/data for materials characterization tasks.
reputation: Niche, domain-specific benchmark used in materials informatics and crystallography research with limited but growing adoption.
notes: Domain-specific, requires domain expertise to label/interpret; small-to-moderate dataset sizes relative to mainstream ML benchmarks; non-LLM / multimodal (image + metadata) focus; possible class imbalance and limited public adoption.
